name: Ballarat NetConnect
summary: Ballarat ISP (NetConnect Communications Pty Ltd, ACN 065 871 927, est. 1994). Its principals joined Chariot Limited by FY2003-04 (2004 Annual Report lists NetConnect's former CEO Ian as Chariot's General Manager and founding shareholder Gary at Chariot; Ballarat listed among Chariot's offices). The 'Chariot netconnect' brand used from c. 2004 derives from this NetConnect lineage; netconnect.com.au redirected to chariot.net.au by 2010 (brand's last use).

events.details: NetConnect Communications Pty Ltd ACN 065871927 incorporated 1994; newsletter Dec 1997 'Ballarat is now 56K!'; earliest capture 1 Feb 1998.

Absorbed into Chariot Limited: NetConnect's former CEO Ian is listed as Chariot General Manager and founding shareholder Gary at Chariot in the FY2003-04 Annual Report (Executive Team), with Ballarat among Chariot's offices. The 'Chariot netconnect' brand (in use by c. 2004-05) derives from this lineage. The domain redirect of netconnect.com.au to chariot.net.au observed by 2010 marks the brand's last use, not the acquisition.
